I have 1.52 hectares here in Singida, and the rains are always uncertain. I will plant my sorghum and groundnut intercrop using the seed I saved from last season, because buying new seed is too expensive when the rain might fail. I cannot afford chemical fertilizer for this plot, but I will put some cattle manure on it because the soil here is very poor. We will work this land ourselves with the hoe, though I may need to hire a few extra hands when it is time for weeding.
